title: Synthesis and alkaline stability of Aquivion-based perfluorinated anion exchange membranes
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8667-8681
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09534D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Li-Cheng Jheng, Yu-Hsiang Tsai, Tai-Hai Huang, Pin-Shen Lin, Chen-Yu Chen, Chun-Jern Pan, Che-Yi Chu
Aquivion-based perfluorinated AEMs with varied tethering structures were synthesized to systematically investigate the effects of sulfonyl-containing linkages, alkyl spacers, and nitrogen-based cyclic cationic groups on alkaline stability.
